text.front:
Innovative approach to local area precise
positioning using direct sequence spread spectrum
David W.A. Taylor and Peter N. Johnson
ENSCO, Inc.
BIOGRAPHY
David Taylor
is ENSCO's Director of Applied
Geophysics and Chief Scientist of the Advanced Projects
and Applications Division.
He holds the PhD in
Geophysics from Virginia Tech and is a Licensed
Professional Geologist.
Peter Johnson
is a Staff Engineer and lead program
engineer in ENSCO's Advanced Projects and
Applications Division. He has 18 years experience in
communications and embedded systems design and
development.
